visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with brown hair and bangs in a bright, modern kitchen. She is wearing a white long-sleeved sweater with red ribbon patterns and a pink apron over it. She smiles at the camera, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. Behind her is a white storage rack holding a microwave, a rice cooker, and other kitchen gadgets. (2) She picks up a large, rectangular, dusty-pink cutting board and holds it in front of her chest. She points at it with her right hand while continuing to speak, focusing the viewer's attention on the product's color and texture. The background remains consistent, showing a clean domestic indoor environment. (3) The camera shows a wider shot as she demonstrates how to tie the apron. She moves her hands to her waist, showing a knot on the right side, then turns slightly to show the strap configuration in the back. She adjusts the apron's fit, highlighting its versatility and how it flatters the waistline. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the side pocket of the apron. Attached to the pocket is a matching pink, plush towel-like fabric held by a button. Her hands demonstrate how the button works, detaching and reattaching the cloth to show its functionality for hand drying during kitchen work. (5) She holds the pink cutting board again, closer to the camera this time. She makes a 'V' sign with her fingers and smiles broadly. Digital graphics like pink sparkles and a cartoon blue sweat drop appear near her head during the final call to action about the sale price and shipping offer.
